meta.purpose: Sample data shapes for the mocked front end. Every product slug and price here matches products.json. Every string matches the copy in site-content.md. This is fixture data, not production data.
conventions: All money is in whole rupees, as integers. No paise anywhere in this business.
Time bands are stored as 24h start/end and rendered as '4:00-6:00 PM'.
Every timestamp on the bake strip is a real event time. Nulls mean 'has not happened yet' and must render as an unticked step, never as a guess.
Placeholder values the founders must set are marked with a TBC string or a null plus a tbc note, so they cannot be shipped by accident.
